title: Biogeochemical Cycles
notes: You have already learnt that living organisms require several chemical elements for their life process.
They may be used as part of their structural component or as parts of enzymes which influence various life processes.
Nutrients are continuously exchanged between the organism and their physical environment.
The cyclic movement of inorganic nutrients or essential elements between abiotic environment and biotic communities is called biogeochemical cycle.
